rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating comparison or limit beyond the previously stated measure
comparative excess beyond the prescribed amount
absolutive expressing prior action leading to consequence
one subject to ritual atonement due to transgression
emphasizes inevitability of the stated consequence

items.question: What ritual consequence necessarily follows when a person performs more than the prescribed action?
premises: A person may act beyond the previously stated prescribed measure.
Exceeding the prescribed ritual action constitutes a transgression.
Such transgression entails the obligation of expiation.
items.inference: Therefore, a person who does more than prescribed certainly becomes subject to expiation.
uncertainties: The exact scope of 'itaḥ' depends on the specific limits defined in the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: If a person does more than this, he certainly becomes one who must perform expiation.
